name: Responses API — direct (no agent)
summary: POST /openai/v1/responses with model='{conn}/{deployment}' and no agent_reference.
description: Smoke test that the Responses API surface itself accepts the BYOM prefix when called outside of any agent abstraction. Same gateway routing as Chat Completions.
notes: Useful as a control for the prompt-agents tests — isolates whether failures live in the agent layer or the underlying responses endpoint.
